backend/main.mo: Actor stores wishes in a List and exposes functions to submit a wish and retrieve all wishes.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence listing routing-related requirements, associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten short summaries for various frontend files describing their purposes and behaviors.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide outlining steps and checks for building, deploying, and verifying the app on the Internet Computer.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining OKLCH color variables, themes, and base styling rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry document loading fonts and mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines TanStack Router setup with hash history and two routes: home and admin wishes.
frontend/src/appDomain.ts: Exports the app domain constant and provides a validation function enforcing length and character rules.
frontend/src/components/CaringMessages.t: Renders a styled message card with three SVG icons representing supportive items.
Canvas animation component that displays timed firework particle bursts with reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer displaying a signature line with name, heart, and date.
frontend/src/components/GiftBox.tsx: Interactive gift box component that opens to reveal a wish panel and triggers confetti or fireworks.
frontend/src/components/HeartsRain.tsx: Canvas animation that renders falling hearts with randomized motion and reduced-motion respect.
frontend/src/components/WishPanel.tsx: UI panel allowing users to type and submit a wish using a mutation, with success and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, login flow, and identity persistence via a React context provider.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalStorage.ts: Custom hook syncing a state value with localStorage for persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for submitting wishes and fetching all wishes via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup with custom pastel theme variables and component styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point that initializes React Query and Internet Identity providers and renders the app.
frontend/src/pages/AdminWishes.tsx: Admin page displaying all submitted wishes with refresh, loading, and error states.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page combining hero text, caring messages, animated hearts, and an interactive gift box.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors, fonts, and plugins.
project_state.json: Contains the full project configuration, architectural notes, known issues, and required features for a pink-themed Get Well Soon webpage with backend wish persistence and a hidden /wishes admin route. Documents routing constraints, deployment issues, and backend interface requirements.
